notes.title: Minor hotfix
notes.notes:
After a minor update yesterday, a small bug was introduced, causing some users to upload their scores with a GPU name missing its VRAM capacity. As a result, those scores were not included in the averages and were considered as different GPU models.

Unfortunately, those few scores had to be removed. If you noticed your score appearing on the leaderboards without the VRAM capacity next to your GPU name, it was affected.

The bug has now been fixed and you can re-run your tests if you’d like to contribute to the leaderboards again.

Apologies for the inconvenience and thank you for understanding.
